test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) E + Z = D * P B U V @ L & F $ O G Q % & M E ? A (Right)

Which of the following is the tenth letter/symbol to the left of the thirteenth letter/symbol from the left end of the given series?
solution:
Given terms: (Left) E + Z = D * P B U V @ L & F $ O G Q % & M E ? A (Right)

Here,

The thirteenth letter/symbol from the left end is: & [E + Z = D * P B U V @ L __**&**__ F $ O G Q % & M E ? A]

And, tenth letter/symbol to the left of & is: Z [E + __**Z**__ = D * P B U V @ L __&__ F $ O G Q % & M E ? A]

So, '**Z**' is the tenth letter/symbol to the left of the thirteenth letter/symbol from the left end of the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
